caveats: The batch was assembled from legacy business directories (Yahoo Local, YellowPages, Superpages, city-data, the NJ nursery directory), so several records may be years old. 7 of 10 are recorded as operating, 3 could not be found at all; only 4 (Bomb Balloon, A. Lammers, Daisy Cleaners, Repairs By Nathan) have a live first-party or map signal, and the other 3 operating entries rest on directory records plus the absence of a closure notice.

Google Maps served a 'limited view' for every search, so review counts were visible only where a third-party aggregator supplied them (Bomb Balloon 71, Repairs By Nathan 79). Ratings without a count are recorded as such.
Google web search hit a CAPTCHA ('unusual traffic') after the first query, so Google was used only through Maps; other facts came from web_search results and direct page fetches.

Inferences are labelled inline; the main ones are that Summerhill Cleaners, Kim's Tailor Shop and Zanco Footwear still trade, that Futon Corner and Weigelia Gardens do not, and that A. Lammers' 'Phillipsburg, NJ 08816' contact line is a typo.
Review text was read only in short summary form; no review is quoted at length.
data_gaps: Review counts for Daisy Dry Cleaners and most other entries could not be read from the limited Google Maps view.
No usable revenue, staff count or ownership data for any business; size judgements rely on locations, suite sizes and review volume.
Bomb Balloon Company's 'Temporarily closed' flag on Google could not be resolved - it may be stale, a hiatus, or a wind-down; there is no first-party channel to check.
Futon Corner, Kids Stuff Consignments and Weigelia Gardens had no live presence to inspect; closure is inferred, not documented.
A. Lammers' actual workshop address is unclear: the site reads 'Phillipsburg, NJ 08816' (city/ZIP mismatch) and no Google Business Profile was found to cross-check.
No contact, quote or booking form was submitted anywhere, per the research rules; whether any form actually delivers mail is untested.
